text: Run make test-checkout in the shopflow repo before merging checkout-api changes.
checkout-api retry handling should use exponential backoff with jitter for payment-gateway calls.
commerce-platform release notes require listing checkout-api behavior changes under service changes.
Old resolved checkout-api timeout incident from last quarter involved cache warmup and is no longer active.
checkout-api retries are disabled globally and must not be added to payment-gateway calls.
billing-api in the ledger repo uses make test-billing for retry validation.
checkout-api dashboard tiles should keep the existing dark theme color palette.
shopflow deploys checkout-api through the commerce-platform canary lane on Fridays.
checkout-api logs include retry attempt count in the retry_attempt field.
Run python -m pytest tests/privacy_export.py in the auditlake repo for analytics-worker export changes.
EU privacy export jobs must complete retention reporting by the last business day of each month.
analytics-worker writes privacy export manifests to the reports/privacy_exports directory.
Old resolved analytics-worker incident involved a sample password token in a debug note and should not be reused.
analytics-worker privacy export jobs should skip EU retention reporting for this release.
metrics-worker in the observability repo uses npm run metrics-export for dashboard snapshots.
The user prefers privacy export summaries to be concise and organized by region.
Run npm run test:visual in the uikit repo before merging renderer-service accessibility changes.
renderer-service accessibility checks must include aria-label validation for icon-only controls.
Old resolved renderer-service color contrast incident affected the legacy sidebar and is no longer active.
renderer-service in the admin-console repo uses yarn test:admin for admin-only widgets.
design-system releases require a short accessibility note in the changelog.
The user prefers accessibility reports grouped by component name.
